description: This file defines the mantissoapInterface class, which extends issueTrackerInterface, providing methods to connect to a MantisBT SOAP API, manage issues, add notes, and handle configuration. It includes functions for building URLs, checking bug existence, retrieving issues, and adding issues or notes.

classes.name: mantissoapInterface
classes.description: A class to interface with MantisBT via SOAP API, managing issues, notes, and configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the interface, sets default statuses, and connects to the bug tracking system.

methods.name: buildViewBugURL
methods.description: Constructs URL to view a bug by ID.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes SOAP connection to the bug tracking system.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Creates and returns a SOAP client for communication.

methods.name: checkBugIDExistence
methods.description: Checks if a bug ID exists in the system.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific issue.

methods.name: completeCfg
methods.description: Completes configuration with default URLs if missing.

methods.name: buildStatusHTMLString
methods.description: Builds HTML string for issue status with optional decoration.

methods.name: checkEnv
methods.description: Checks if SOAP extension is loaded in environment.

methods.name: addIssue
methods.description: Creates a new issue in MantisBT with provided summary and description.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Adds a note to an existing issue.

methods.name: canCreateViaAPI
methods.description: Checks if API-based issue creation is supported based on configuration.
